import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    return (p[0] + p[1]*P + p[2]*P**2 + p[3]*P**3 + p[4]*t + p[5]*t**2
            + p[6]*P*t + p[7]*P*t**2 + p[8]*P**2*t + p[9]*P*np.log(P))
